query.statement: SELECT WO_ID, MAINTENANCE_PLAN_ID AS PLAN_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, WO_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, ASSIGNEE_ID, ISSUED_AT, STARTED_AT, COMPLETED_AT, STATUS, FAILURE_CODE_ID, REMARK FROM EMS_WORK_ORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY ISSUED_AT DESC
SELECT STATUS, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM EMS_WORK_ORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) GROUP BY STATUS ORDER BY STATUS

SELECT W.WO_ID, W.PLAN_ID AS LEGACY_PLAN_ID, W.MAINTENANCE_PLAN_ID, CASE WHEN E.PLAN_ID IS NOT NULL AND P.PLAN_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Ambiguous' WHEN E.PLAN_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'EmsOnly' WHEN P.PLAN_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'PomOnly' ELSE 'Orphan' END AS MIGRATION_CLASS FROM EMS_WORK_ORDER W WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN EMS_MAINTENANCE_PLAN E WITH (NOLOCK) ON E.PLAN_ID = W.PLAN_ID LEFT JOIN POM_PRODUCTION_PLAN P WITH (NOLOCK) ON P.PLAN_ID = W.PLAN_ID WHERE W.PLAN_ID IS NOT NULL AND W.MAINTENANCE_PLAN_ID IS NULL ORDER BY W.WO_ID

SELECT PLAN_ID, PLAN_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, PLAN_TYPE, CYCLE_TYPE, SCHEDULED_DATE, ESTIMATED_DURATION_HOURS, ASSIGNEE_ID, STATUS FROM EMS_MAINTENANCE_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY SCHEDULED_DATE

SELECT PLAN_ID, PLAN_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, PLAN_TYPE, CYCLE_TYPE, SCHEDULED_DATE, ESTIMATED_DURATION_HOURS, ASSIGNEE_ID, STATUS FROM EMS_MAINTENANCE_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE SCHEDULED_DATE <= @asOf AND STATUS NOT IN ('Completed', 'Cancelled') ORDER BY SCHEDULED_DATE

SELECT TOP 500 WO_ID, MAINTENANCE_PLAN_ID AS PLAN_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, WO_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, ASSIGNEE_ID, ISSUED_AT, STARTED_AT, COMPLETED_AT, STATUS, FAILURE_CODE_ID, REMARK FROM EMS_WORK_ORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY ISSUED_AT DESC, WO_ID DESC

SELECT PLAN_ID, PLAN_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, PLAN_TYPE, CYCLE_TYPE, SCHEDULED_DATE, ESTIMATED_DURATION_HOURS, ASSIGNEE_ID, STATUS FROM EMS_MAINTENANCE_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY SCHEDULED_DATE
SELECT PART_ID, PART_NAME, PART_NUMBER, DESCRIPTION, UNIT_OF_MEASURE, CURRENT_STOCK, MIN_STOCK, MAX_STOCK, LOCATION, EQUIPMENT_CLASS_ID FROM EMS_SPARE_PART WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY PART_NAME

SELECT PART_ID, PART_NAME, PART_NUMBER, DESCRIPTION, UNIT_OF_MEASURE, CURRENT_STOCK, MIN_STOCK, MAX_STOCK, LOCATION, EQUIPMENT_CLASS_ID FROM EMS_SPARE_PART WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CURRENT_STOCK <= MIN_STOCK ORDER BY PART_NAME
SELECT ITEM_CLASS_ID, ITEM_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM EMS_MAINT_ITEM_CLASS WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@itemClassId IS NULL OR ITEM_CLASS_ID = @itemClassId) ORDER BY ITEM_CLASS_NAME

SELECT ITEM_ID, ITEM_NAME, ITEM_CLASS_ID, INSPECTION_METHOD, UNIT, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM EMS_MAINT_ITEM WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@itemClassId IS NULL OR ITEM_CLASS_ID = @itemClassId) ORDER BY ITEM_NAME

SELECT EQP_ITEM_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, ITEM_ID, CYCLE_TYPE, CYCLE_VALUE, IS_ACTIVE FROM EMS_EQP_MAINT_ITEM WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) ORDER BY EQUIPMENT_ID, ITEM_ID
SELECT PART_CLASS_ID, PART_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM EMS_SPARE_PART_CLASS WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@partClassId IS NULL OR PART_CLASS_ID = @partClassId) ORDER BY PART_CLASS_NAME

SELECT INOUT_ID, PART_ID, TRANSACTION_TYPE, QUANTITY, FROM_LOCATION, TO_LOCATION, TRANSACTION_AT, PROCESSED_BY, WO_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, BALANCE_BEFORE, BALANCE_AFTER, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, CORRELATION_ID, CLIENT_CHANNEL, DEVICE_ID, REMARK FROM EMS_SPARE_PART_INOUT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@transactionType IS NULL OR TRANSACTION_TYPE = @transactionType) AND (@partId IS NULL OR PART_ID = @partId) ORDER BY TRANSACTION_AT DESC

SELECT INOUT_ID, PART_ID, TRANSACTION_TYPE, QUANTITY, FROM_LOCATION, TO_LOCATION, TRANSACTION_AT, PROCESSED_BY, WO_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, BALANCE_BEFORE, BALANCE_AFTER, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, CORRELATION_ID, CLIENT_CHANNEL, DEVICE_ID, REMARK FROM EMS_SPARE_PART_INOUT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'Incoming' AND (@partId IS NULL OR PART_ID = @partId) ORDER BY TRANSACTION_AT DESC

SELECT INOUT_ID, PART_ID, TRANSACTION_TYPE, QUANTITY, FROM_LOCATION, TO_LOCATION, TRANSACTION_AT, PROCESSED_BY, WO_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, BALANCE_BEFORE, BALANCE_AFTER, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, CORRELATION_ID, CLIENT_CHANNEL, DEVICE_ID, REMARK FROM EMS_SPARE_PART_INOUT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'Move' AND (@partId IS NULL OR PART_ID = @partId) ORDER BY TRANSACTION_AT DESC

SELECT INOUT_ID, PART_ID, TRANSACTION_TYPE, QUANTITY, FROM_LOCATION, TO_LOCATION, TRANSACTION_AT, PROCESSED_BY, WO_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, BALANCE_BEFORE, BALANCE_AFTER, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, CORRELATION_ID, CLIENT_CHANNEL, DEVICE_ID, REMARK FROM EMS_SPARE_PART_INOUT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'Scrap' AND (@partId IS NULL OR PART_ID = @partId) ORDER BY TRANSACTION_AT DESC

SELECT TOP 500 ACTION_ID, WO_ID, MAINTENANCE_PLAN_ID AS PLAN_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, MAINTENANCE_TYPE, ACTION_TYPE, RESULT_STATUS, ACTOR_ID, ASSIGNEE_ID, SOURCE, CLIENT_CHANNEL, DEVICE_ID, FAILURE_CODE_ID, REMARK, ACTION_AT, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, FROM_STATUS, TO_STATUS, CORRELATION_ID FROM EMS_MAINTENANCE_ACTION_HISTORY WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@workOrderId IS NULL OR WO_ID = @workOrderId) AND (@maintenancePlanId IS NULL OR MAINTENANCE_PLAN_ID = @maintenancePlanId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@actorId IS NULL OR ACTOR_ID = @actorId) AND (@from IS NULL OR ACTION_AT >= @from) AND (@to IS NULL OR ACTION_AT < @to) ORDER BY ACTION_AT DESC

SELECT p.PART_ID, p.PART_NAME, p.CURRENT_STOCK, s.SAFETY_STOCK, s.REORDER_POINT, s.TARGET_STOCK, s.RESERVED_QTY, s.AVG_DAILY_USAGE, s.SERVICE_LEVEL, s.REVIEW_CYCLE_DAYS, s.IS_ACTIVE, s.VERSION_NO, s.UPDATED_BY, s.UPDATED_AT FROM EMS_SPARE_PART_STOCK_POLICY s WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN EMS_SPARE_PART p WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.PART_ID=s.PART_ID WHERE (@partId IS NULL OR s.PART_ID=@partId) AND (@isActive IS NULL OR s.IS_ACTIVE=@isActive) ORDER BY p.PART_NAME

SELECT PART_SUPPLIER_ID, PART_ID, VENDOR_ID, VENDOR_PART_NO, LEAD_TIME_DAYS, MOQ, UNIT_PRICE, CURRENCY, IS_PRIMARY, IS_ACTIVE, VERSION_NO, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM EMS_SPARE_PART_SUPPLIER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@partId IS NULL OR PART_ID=@partId) AND (@vendorId IS NULL OR VENDOR_ID=@vendorId) AND (@isActive IS NULL OR IS_ACTIVE=@isActive) ORDER BY PART_ID, IS_PRIMARY DESC, LEAD_TIME_DAYS

SELECT BOM_ITEM_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, EQUIPMENT_CLASS_ID, PART_ID, QUANTITY_PER, CRITICALITY, REPLACEMENT_CYCLE_DAYS, REPLACEMENT_CYCLE_COUNT, POSITION_CODE, IS_ACTIVE, VERSION_NO, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM EMS_EQUIPMENT_PART_BOM WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID=@equipmentId) AND (@equipmentClassId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_CLASS_ID=@equipmentClassId) AND (@partId IS NULL OR PART_ID=@partId) AND (@isActive IS NULL OR IS_ACTIVE=@isActive) ORDER BY EQUIPMENT_ID, EQUIPMENT_CLASS_ID, POSITION_CODE, PART_ID

WITH ranked_supplier AS ( SELECT PART_SUPPLIER_ID, PART_ID, VENDOR_ID, LEAD_TIME_DAYS, MOQ, UNIT_PRICE, CURRENCY, IS_PRIMARY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY PART_ID ORDER BY IS_PRIMARY DESC, LEAD_TIME_DAYS, COALESCE(UNIT_PRICE, 999999999), PART_SUPPLIER_ID ) AS SUPPLIER_RANK FROM EMS_SPARE_PART_SUPPLIER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IS_ACTIVE=1 ) SELECT p.PART_ID, p.PART_NAME, p.CURRENT_STOCK, s.SAFETY_STOCK, s.REORDER_POINT, s.TARGET_STOCK, s.RESERVED_QTY, s.AVG_DAILY_USAGE, s.SERVICE_LEVEL, s.REVIEW_CYCLE_DAYS, s.VERSION_NO, r.PART_SUPPLIER_ID, r.VENDOR_ID, r.LEAD_TIME_DAYS, r.MOQ, r.UNIT_PRICE, r.CURRENCY, r.IS_PRIMARY FROM EMS_SPARE_PART_STOCK_POLICY s WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN EMS_SPARE_PART p WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.PART_ID=s.PART_ID LEFT JOIN ranked_supplier r ON r.PART_ID=s.PART_ID AND r.SUPPLIER_RANK=1 WHERE s.PART_ID=@partId AND s.IS_ACTIVE=1

SELECT TOP 500 USAGE_ID, INOUT_ID, PART_ID, BOM_ITEM_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, WO_ID, QUANTITY, USED_BY, USED_AT, REMOVAL_REASON, SERIAL_NO, LOT_NO FROM EMS_SPARE_PART_USAGE WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@partId IS NULL OR PART_ID=@partId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID=@equipmentId) AND (@workOrderId IS NULL OR WO_ID=@workOrderId) AND (@from IS NULL OR USED_AT>=@from) AND (@to IS NULL OR USED_AT<@to) ORDER BY USED_AT DESC

SELECT TOP 500 USAGE_ID, INOUT_ID, PART_ID, BOM_ITEM_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, WO_ID, QUANTITY, USED_BY, USED_AT, REMOVAL_REASON, SERIAL_NO, LOT_NO FROM EMS_SPARE_PART_USAGE WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE WO_ID=@workOrderId AND (@from IS NULL OR USED_AT>=@from) AND (@to IS NULL OR USED_AT<@to) ORDER BY USED_AT DESC

SELECT TOOL_ID, TOOL_NAME, TOOL_TYPE, TOOL_NUMBER, SERIAL_NO, EQUIPMENT_CLASS_ID, MAX_USE_COUNT, MAX_USE_MINUTES, CURRENT_USE_COUNT, CURRENT_USE_MINUTES, INSPECTION_CYCLE_DAYS, CALIBRATION_CYCLE_DAYS, LAST_INSPECTED_AT, LAST_CALIBRATED_AT, NEXT_INSPECTION_DUE_AT, NEXT_CALIBRATION_DUE_AT, STATUS, LOCATION, IS_ACTIVE FROM EMS_TOOL WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@toolType IS NULL OR TOOL_TYPE=@toolType) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS=@status) AND (@isActive IS NULL OR IS_ACTIVE=@isActive) ORDER BY TOOL_TYPE, TOOL_NAME

SELECT TOP 500 MOUNT_ID, TOOL_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, POSITION_CODE, MOUNTED_AT, MOUNTED_BY, UNMOUNTED_AT, UNMOUNTED_BY, UNMOUNT_REASON FROM EMS_TOOL_MOUNT_HISTORY WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@toolId IS NULL OR TOOL_ID=@toolId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID=@equipmentId) AND (@activeOnly IS NULL OR @activeOnly=0 OR UNMOUNTED_AT IS NULL) ORDER BY MOUNTED_AT DESC

SELECT TOP 500 USAGE_ID, TOOL_ID, MOUNT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PROCESS_LOT_ID, WORK_ORDER_ID, PROCESS_ID, RECIPE_ID, RECIPE_VERSION, USE_COUNT, USE_MINUTES, USED_AT, USED_BY, TRACE_ID, CONDITION_SNAPSHOT_JSON FROM EMS_TOOL_USAGE_HISTORY WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@toolId IS NULL OR TOOL_ID=@toolId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID=@equipmentId) AND (@from IS NULL OR USED_AT>=@from) AND (@to IS NULL OR USED_AT<@to) ORDER BY USED_AT DESC

SELECT TOP 500 INSPECTION_ID, TOOL_ID, INSPECTION_TYPE, RESULT, MEASURED_VALUE, STANDARD_VALUE, CERTIFICATE_NO, INSPECTED_AT, INSPECTED_BY, NEXT_DUE_AT, REMARK FROM EMS_TOOL_INSPECTION_HISTORY WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@toolId IS NULL OR TOOL_ID=@toolId) AND (@inspectionType IS NULL OR INSPECTION_TYPE=@inspectionType) AND (@from IS NULL OR INSPECTED_AT>=@from) AND (@to IS NULL OR INSPECTED_AT<@to) ORDER BY INSPECTED_AT DESC

SELECT SCHEDULE_ID, MAINTENANCE_PLAN_ID, TRIGGER_TYPE, INTERVAL_VALUE, INTERVAL_UNIT, TIME_ZONE_ID, LAST_DUE_AT, NEXT_DUE_AT, METER_PARAMETER_ID, METER_THRESHOLD, METER_BASELINE_VALUE, NEXT_METER_DUE_VALUE, CONDITION_RULE_ID, AUTO_CREATE_WO, IS_ACTIVE, VERSION_NO FROM EMS_MAINTENANCE_SCHEDULE WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@maintenancePlanId IS NULL OR MAINTENANCE_PLAN_ID=@maintenancePlanId) AND (@triggerType IS NULL OR TRIGGER_TYPE=@triggerType) AND (@isActive IS NULL OR IS_ACTIVE=@isActive) ORDER BY NEXT_DUE_AT, SCHEDULE_ID

SELECT TOP 500 ACK_ID, SCHEDULE_ID, MAINTENANCE_PLAN_ID, TRIGGER_TYPE, DUE_AT, NEXT_DUE_AT, METER_DUE_VALUE, OBSERVED_METER_VALUE, NEXT_METER_DUE_VALUE, CONDITION_RULE_ID, CONDITION_MET, ACKNOWLEDGED_AT, ACKNOWLEDGED_BY, REMARK, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, CLIENT_CHANNEL, DEVICE_ID, CORRELATION_ID, FROM_VERSION, TO_VERSION FROM EMS_MAINTENANCE_SCHEDULE_ACK_HISTORY WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@scheduleId IS NULL OR SCHEDULE_ID=@scheduleId) AND (@actorId IS NULL OR ACKNOWLEDGED_BY=@actorId) AND (@from IS NULL OR ACKNOWLEDGED_AT>=@from) AND (@to IS NULL OR ACKNOWLEDGED_AT<@to) ORDER BY ACKNOWLEDGED_AT DESC

SELECT TOP 500 CHECK_RESULT_ID, WO_ID, ITEM_ID, ITEM_SEQUENCE, CHECK_NAME, MEASURED_VALUE, ATTRIBUTE_VALUE, UNIT, IS_PASS, FINDING, RECORDED_BY, RECORDED_AT, CLIENT_CHANNEL, DEVICE_ID, CORRELATION_ID, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY FROM EMS_WORK_ORDER_CHECK_RESULT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@workOrderId IS NULL OR WO_ID=@workOrderId) AND (@itemId IS NULL OR ITEM_ID=@itemId) AND (@actorId IS NULL OR RECORDED_BY=@actorId) AND (@from IS NULL OR RECORDED_AT>=@from) AND (@to IS NULL OR RECORDED_AT<@to) ORDER BY RECORDED_AT DESC, ITEM_SEQUENCE

SELECT TOP 500 LABOR_ID, WO_ID, USER_ID, WORKER_ID, LABOR_TYPE, STARTED_AT, ENDED_AT, ENDED_BY, LABOR_HOURS, REMARK, CORRELATION_ID, START_CLIENT_CHANNEL, START_DEVICE_ID, END_CLIENT_CHANNEL, END_DEVICE_ID, VERSION_NO FROM EMS_WORK_ORDER_LABOR WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@workOrderId IS NULL OR WO_ID=@workOrderId) AND (@userId IS NULL OR USER_ID=@userId) AND (@workerId IS NULL OR WORKER_ID=@workerId) AND (@openOnly IS NULL OR @openOnly=0 OR ENDED_AT IS NULL) AND (@from IS NULL OR STARTED_AT>=@from) AND (@to IS NULL OR STARTED_AT<@to) ORDER BY STARTED_AT DESC

SELECT WORKER_USER_MAP_ID, WORKER_ID, USER_ID, IS_ACTIVE, EFFECTIVE_FROM, EFFECTIVE_TO, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM MDM_WORKER_USER_MAP WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@workerId IS NULL OR WORKER_ID=@workerId) AND (@userId IS NULL OR USER_ID=@userId) AND (@isActive IS NULL OR IS_ACTIVE=@isActive) ORDER BY USER_ID, EFFECTIVE_FROM DESC
